continuity_conflict.details: The chapter attributes the seven witness killings directly to Sloane ('The seven people I... eliminated' and 'He made me kill the witnesses'), while the series bible establishes that Lucian was the assassin who eliminated them and that Sloane ordered the deaths. It also states that Rook already has Mara in chapter 13, although the supporting-cast canon places Mara's capture in chapter 14.
